note: Files: studies/rlneurons/results/axis/math500-01/vectors.json + manifest.json, studies/rlneurons/results/rln4/t1_t2_items-01/per_problem.json (all committed, no fetch). manifest.json has no 'model' field: base arms are found as family base_cue, prompt cue, derived_from null, with 'sample i' in 'what' (base_cue_s0..s3, which excludes base_vote4/base_tie_short), and the Code 3.0 arm as the only non-derived cue arm whose 'what' names Olmo-3-7B-RL-Zero-Code (code30_cue). random_cue is never used. Q4 = ranks 376-500 by t2_generated_tokens (the RL T2 answer length, cap hits at their stored count), ties by problem_index. A null or missing vector entry counts as 0. E empty -> 0. alt_measured is the same statistic with the Code-RL 3.1 cue arm (code_cue), in case 'Code 3.0' was meant as the Code-RL model of the main study (the inventory names 3.1 as Code-RL). refuted_by is null, so refuted_by_met is always false.

Same files, arms and Q4 as k=3. d_i = (base s2 + base s3)/2 - code30_cue over all 125 Q4 problems; H = Q4 with base s0 + s1 <= 1 (not both right). Ratio sum_H d / sum_Q4 d; denominator <= 0 -> 0. The ratio can be > 1 or < 0 when d has mixed signs. alt_measured uses code_cue (Code-RL 3.1) instead of code30_cue. example_row is the first H problem (by length rank).

Same files and arms as k=3. Q1+Q2 = ranks 1-250 by t2_generated_tokens ascending, ties by problem_index. H2 = those with base s0 + s1 <= 1. Statistic = mean code30_cue over H2 minus mean (s2+s3)/2 over H2; empty -> 0. H2 may be small (the base gets most short problems right), so the number is noisy. alt_measured uses code_cue (Code-RL 3.1).
